618	How many times have I told about Rav Ben Zion Abba Shaul, who used to walk around these neighborhoods; he lived right here, he would	Quantas vezes contei sobre o Rav Ben Tsion Abba Shaul, que andava por estes bairros; ele morava bem aqui, e costumava
